name: High-severity noise (the scenario that can actually discriminate)
_why: The other three scenarios cannot measure an engine. Their decoys are LOW severity, so remediate.WorthProposing drops them on severity alone and the substrate scores a perfect 0 decoy-actions without exercising any judgement — no headroom, so agent and substrate must tie. Here every decoy is HIGH and sits in ordinary application code, outside any test/fixture/docs path, so neither the severity rule nor the path heuristic can save an engine. Only knowing what the finding MEANS separates them. Descriptions state facts only and never the verdict: the earlier triage corpus leaked by writing conclusions into the decoy text, and a corpus that says the answer measures reading, not judgement.
